behavior: Bound comparisons <= >= < > ≤ ≥ ≦ ≧ and their NFKC/Cf detection spellings use shared anchored qualifiers on either operand edge, including explicit layout. They cannot create a precise amount.
Postposed uncertainty accepts only an optional finite amount/number label 金额/金額/数额/數額 before the established unknown markers. An unrelated owner or sentence is not a bridge.

New 按-unit rate branch recognizes hour/month/day/piece units with finite calculation/pay endings and right boundary. Bare 按时 is excluded; 按时支付, 按月15日 and unlisted prose are not denominators. Existing slash/每 behavior is unchanged.
One whole-money ending before a valid new 按 rate can survive a clipped value; unknown markers after that rate still null the amount. No numeric, currency, range or arithmetic guard is removed.
Traditional no-amount wage labels additionally fold 實總額計 only in a detection copy. Pure bounded RMB/unit labels are not_monetary; real amounts, unknown/masked strings remain reviewable.
Raw values, quotes, code-point positions, stored input history and the no-auto-upgrade rule are asserted by synthetic source/history tests.
